description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mrs. Soma Wijesuriya of the One Part and Ceylon Petroleum Corporation, Ceylon Petroleum Storage of the Other Part
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, statutory instruments, and regulatory compliance matters related to industrial dispute resolution. The content focuses on the legal framework for settling disputes between employees and employers, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
